calculation.description: Ranks instruments by the negative recent overnight gap, scaled by 20-day realized volatility. Larger adverse recent gaps receive higher reversal scores for a five-trading-day forward horizon. Uses only completed daily OHLC data.

validation.regime_notes: Positive aggregate IC and ICIR, but regime means weakened after 2022 and turned negative in 2025-2026; results are conservative for the small 15-instrument cross-section. The latest 2029 partial regime had unstable rank correlations and was not used to claim robustness.
validation.lookahead_check: Signal uses open and close through the observation date only; forward close returns are used solely for validation.
